gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads sturdy and wide-mouthed, a hefty lowercase, while Comic Relief stitches its letters from thread-like strokes. Whole pages of it would feel solid, unhurried and never tiring.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-ranade: Ranade reads loose and springy, its weight shifting slightly like stretched rubber cord, while Comic Relief holds every line at constant thickness. Over pages, this sans-serif would feel widely spaced and organic.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a thick band of text whose letters stay held open rather than curling shut. And Comic Relief, whose crossbars match its upright stems in weight, supplies the loudest note.
gen-gf-comic-relief-general-sans: Comic Relief comes across bold and commanding, bowls left open on one side. Display punch is its strength, while General Sans, its x-height filling the line, is best at smooth running text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-orbit: Professional in tone, Orbit lets its curves stop short and its characters float apart. But Comic Relief is the one built to shout, while Orbit is built to hold quiet, consistent lines.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-science-gothic: Bowls left unfinished on one side give Comic Relief its swagger. Science Gothic, a sans-serif with uniform strokes and wide-set stroke ends, is the approachable counterweight to that commanding display face.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-syncopate: Spaced like rungs on a rope ladder, the body text feels drawn with a technical pen. Syncopate stays open and measured, a sharp foil for the bold, commanding Comic Relief heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-manrope: Approachable and bright, the body text opens a wide mouth at every curve, under a Comic Relief heading. Manrope stands taller in the lowercase than Comic Relief, and that height gap defines the pair.
gen-gf-comic-relief-montserrat: Strokes that never thicken or thin mark Comic Relief out, bowls left unfinished on one side. Montserrat would glide under the eye like wire, line after line, with generous white space leading into every curve.
gen-gf-comic-relief-satoshi: Comic Relief shouts with moderate-height lowercase and bowls left open on one side. Satoshi, with its soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed, would read smoothly page after page.
